account-intelligence: Use when researching companies and their people before outreach: full dossier per account and person, relevance scores, Entry Plan (angle, offer, entry person, path) and sourced personalization lines, in batches with QA.
apify-actors: Use when running Apify actors for P4G sourcing and signals: which actor for which job, inputs, costs, risks, and a self-learning loop that reads each actor's schema, tests small and records what works.
client-niche-brief: Use when onboarding a client from their website: research their business and industry, the niche's language, draft ICP, anti-ICP and personas, and list what the client must provide and approve.
cold-offer-writing: Use when writing or reviewing a cold B2B offer or first message, translating a service into an outcome the buyer gets, or planning which offer × list campaigns to test.
cold-outreach-system: Use when planning or running a B2B cold outreach campaign for a client (email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Viber, SMS, phone, events, ABM), onboarding a new outreach client, or diagnosing why a campaign gets no replies.
directory-browser-extractor: Use in Claude Code to open a directory in a real browser, learn its structure and available fields, save a reusable directory profile, then extract every company, visiting detail pages one by one when needed.
directory-website-verifier: Use when extracting companies from directories or checking company websites in bulk to verify ICP fit, including sites that block simple fetches, with evidence-based verdicts.
google-maps-sourcing: Use when building a company list from Google Maps for CEE markets: local-language queries per city, deduped CSV of businesses, then ICP qualification before any paid enrichment.
google-search-discovery: Use when looking for new source lists with Google search operators: association member lists, fair exhibitor lists, directories, distributor pages and PDFs per country and language.
lead-data-hygiene: Use when cleaning and merging lead data from Prospeo, AI Ark, Google/Maps, directories and other sources: dedupe and cross-source matching, company and person name normalization, job titles, email validation.
outreach-compliance-cee: Use before any cold outreach campaign in CEE/DACH/Greece: P4G channel policy per country, legal risk tier, required first-message elements, GDPR duties, registers to check and risk mitigations.
outreach-deliverability: Use when setting up, auditing or fixing cold email deliverability: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warm-up, live/spare domain fleet, bounce or spam spikes, blacklists, and when to buy, promote or retire domains.
outreach-evaluation: Use when evaluating a cold outreach campaign or system: benchmarks, positive reply scoring, list quality grading, offer experiments, the weekly operating rhythm, and client reporting.
outreach-icp-onboarding: Use when onboarding a new cold outreach client: turning the Niche & ICP Brief into client-approved ICP, anti-ICP and personas, running the approval set and calibration, and building the Do Not Contact list.
outreach-infrastructure-channels: Use when setting up cold outreach infrastructure and channels: email sending setup, LinkedIn profile, channel order, phone, WhatsApp and Viber follow-up, tracking, follow-up cadence and appointment booking.
outreach-lead-sourcing: Use when building or refreshing a prospect database for B2B cold outreach: TAM mapping with AI Ark, Prospeo and niche sources, event signals, ICP verification, people and contacts, and tiering by channel.
outreach-report-client: Use to write a client-facing daily or weekly outreach report for one P4G client: results, honest reasons when results are missing, what we need from the client, and next steps.
outreach-report-internal: Use for P4G's internal daily and weekly outreach report across all clients and P4G's own pipeline: results, red flags, and a root-cause diagnosis of why results are missing.
outreach-sequence-copywriting: Use when writing outreach sequences per channel (email, LinkedIn, phone, WhatsApp/Viber follow-up, re-engagement) from an approved offer, niche brief and prospect research, with QA and compliance checks.
p4g-outreach-architecture: Use when deciding what runs in Claude vs Hermes, wiring P4G systems (GetSales, Smartlead, Prospeo, AI Ark, Apify, Serper, CRM, messaging), or defining the shared data model and handoffs between them.
phone-channel-pipeline: Use when collecting, validating and using phone numbers: Hermes intake, normalization, line-type checks for SMS, WhatsApp/Viber eligibility, call lists, and agent-run follow-up messaging after a reply.
prospect-source-finder: Use when the current stack finds too few relevant prospects: diagnose the gap, find where the ICP can be found, scout and test databases and tools, and prepare an approval packet.
prospect-tiering: Use when assigning every prospect a priority tier, contact profile and channel play (named work email, office email, LinkedIn, phone, follow-up messaging), and when re-tiering after signals or replies.
website-keyword-check: Use when checking whether each company's own website mentions a specific keyword (certification, service, brand, country), to filter a list or create a sourced personalization line.
